question: List all products along with their BOM version details, including only those products which have at least one BOM version associated, sorted by product name and version number.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material) GROUP BY s.name, s.contact_info RETURN s.name, s.contact_info, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS material_count ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 5')

question: Find the average unit cost of materials that are part of products with a revision level of 'C' and are sourced from suppliers with a contract term indicating 'Net 30'. Return the average unit cost.
sql: SELECT graph.average_unit_cost FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (p:Product{revision_level:''C''})-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Supplier) WHERE s.contract_terms = ''Net 30'' RETURN AVG(m.unit_cost) AS average_unit_cost') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(average_unit_cost DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (p:Product{revision_level:''C''})-[:ConsistsOf]->(m:Material)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Supplier) WHERE s.contract_terms = ''Net 30'' RETURN AVG(m.unit_cost) AS average_unit_cost')

question: For each work center that has manufactured products with more than one Bom version, find the work center ID, name, and the number of distinct Bom versions associated with the products it has manufactured.
sql: SELECT graph.WorkCenter_id, graph.name, graph.COUNTDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[:ManufacturedAt]-(p:Product)-[:HasBomVersion]->(bv:BomVersion) GROUP BY wc.WorkCenter_id, wc.name RETURN wc.WorkCenter_id, wc.name, COUNT(DISTINCT bv)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(WorkCenter_id INT PATH '$[0]', name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', COUNTDISTINCT INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[:ManufacturedAt]-(p:Product)-[:HasBomVersion]->(bv:BomVersion) GROUP BY wc.WorkCenter_id, wc.name RETURN wc.WorkCenter_id, wc.name, COUNT(DISTINCT bv)')

question: Find the average setup time for manufacturing orders of products that have undergone at least two engineering changes.
sql: SELECT graph.AverageSetupTime FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[:OrderedFor]->(p:Product)-[:ModifiedBy]->(ec:EngineeringChange), (p)-[m:ManufacturedAt]->(:WorkCenter) RETURN AVG(m.setup_time) AS AverageSetupTime') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(AverageSetupTime DOUBLE PATH '$[0]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (mo:ManufacturingOrder)-[:OrderedFor]->(p:Product)-[:ModifiedBy]->(ec:EngineeringChange), (p)-[m:ManufacturedAt]->(:WorkCenter) RETURN AVG(m.setup_time) AS AverageSetupTime')

question: Identify the top 10 work centers with the highest total setup time across all manufacturing orders, including only those with more than 5 associated manufacturing activities. Return the work center name and the aggregated setup time.
sql: SELECT graph.name, graph.setup_time FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(:Product)<-[:OrderedFor]-(mo:ManufacturingOrder) GROUP BY wc.name RETURN wc.name, SUM(ma.setup_time) ORDER BY SUM(ma.setup_time) DESC LIMIT 10') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', setup_time INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (wc:WorkCenter)<-[ma:ManufacturedAt]-(:Product)<-[:OrderedFor]-(mo:ManufacturingOrder) GROUP BY wc.name RETURN wc.name, SUM(ma.setup_time) ORDER BY SUM(ma.setup_time) DESC LIMIT 10')

question: List the top 5 suppliers by total contract value, calculated as the product of unit cost and minimum order quantity for materials they supply, including only those suppliers whose materials are part of active BOM versions.
sql: SELECT graph.Supplier_id, graph.name, graph.unit_cost FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(n)-[:HasBomVersion]->(:BomVersion{status:''Active''}) GROUP BY s.Supplier_id, s.name RETURN s.Supplier_id, s.name, SUM(m.unit_cost) ORDER BY SUM(m.unit_cost) DESC LIMIT 5') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(Supplier_id INT PATH '$[0]', name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', unit_cost DOUBLE PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('manufacturing_bombill_of_materials', 'MATCH (s:Supplier)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(m:Material)<-[:ConsistsOf]-(n)-[:HasBomVersion]->(:BomVersion{status:''Active''}) GROUP BY s.Supplier_id, s.name RETURN s.Supplier_id, s.name, SUM(m.unit_cost) ORDER BY SUM(m.unit_cost) DESC LIMIT 5')
